ranking_method: Saniya project heuristic v1; see docs/SCIENCE_METHODOLOGY.md. Not a NASA standard.

targets.name: Jezero western delta panorama area
targets.scientific_objective: Document sedimentary architecture and facies relationships to constrain the history of water and sediment deposition in Jezero Crater.
targets.scientific_significance: NASA describes a river-fed delta setting and layered sedimentary rocks; fine-grained delta deposits are investigation priorities because they may preserve records of past environments. This is evidence of a potentially habitable ancient environment, not evidence of life.

recommended_investigations.question: How do bedding geometry and grain-size changes vary across the exposed delta section?
recommended_investigations.action: Record high-resolution images and measured stratigraphic relationships across accessible exposures; distinguish direct observations from depositional interpretations.

recommended_investigations.question: Do fine-grained and coarser beds differ in composition or alteration?
recommended_investigations.action: Compare in-situ compositional measurements across visibly distinct beds and document the exact sample locations and instrument products.

recommended_investigations.question: Which contacts are sharp, gradational, or erosional?
recommended_investigations.action: Map contact geometry and collect contextual imagery before sampling representative units.

evidence_sources.source_type: NASA Science panorama resource and mission science-team explanation
evidence_sources.supports: Mastcam-Z panorama aggregate, sols 466/467/470/471/474, named Hogwallow Flats and Skinner Ridge, layered sedimentary rocks, and NASA's interpretation of the delta environment.
Authoritative archive location for Mars 2020 instrument and rover data; product-level coordinates and image IDs still need to be joined from the relevant PDS products.

targets.confidence_rationale: The broad landform and layered-rock context are described by NASA from Mastcam-Z imagery, but the catalogue currently lacks individual image product IDs, registered rover coordinates, and P2 GIS layers.
limitations: No point coordinates are published in the cited NASA resource; coordinates and CRS are deliberately null.
The catalogue record points to the NASA aggregate resource, not to all 1,118 individual PDS image products.
Astronaut recommendations are proposed field methods and are not claims that new measurements or discoveries exist.
No accessibility, terrain hazard, route distance, or route-safety judgment is included.

priority_input_rationale.scientific_significance: 4: NASA identifies the delta as a primary mission science area and explains its ancient river/lake significance.
priority_input_rationale.evidence_strength: 3: direct Mastcam-Z imagery and NASA science-team interpretation support the broad context, but the raw PDS frame-level join is pending.
priority_input_rationale.observation_availability: 3: one NASA-published panorama assembled from 1,118 frames is cited; individual product IDs are not in this record.
priority_input_rationale.geological_diversity: 3: NASA describes layered sedimentary exposures and boulders in the panorama area; detailed mapped facies are not included here.
priority_input_rationale.investigation_value: 4: stratigraphy, contacts, and composition are concrete follow-up questions tied to the described deposits.
